title: Multistatic ISAC with Deep Learning-Based Clutter Suppression for 5G and Beyond
abstract: arXiv:2610.40586v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) systems using 5G and beyond signals of opportunity enable joint wireless sensing and communication using shared infrastructure and spectrum resources. While multistatic ISAC can increase sensing coverage with spatially distributed receivers, dense and dynamic clutter can significantly degrade bistatic range and Doppler estimation, leading to errors in target localization and velocity estimation. This paper presents a multistatic ISAC framework with clutter suppression for high-fidelity estimation of target position and velocity. Distributed clutter is modeled with randomly located scatterers with varying Doppler spreads and radar cross sections to capture dense and dynamic clutter effects. A broad range of conventional signal processing baselines are evaluated for clutter suppression, showing limited robustness under strong clutter conditions. translated_abstract: 摘要：利用5G及未来通信机会信号的通感一体化（ISAC）系统，能够在共享基础设施和频谱资源的前提下实现无线感知与通信的融合。虽然多基地ISAC可以通过空间上分布的接收机扩展感知覆盖范围，但密集且动态变化的杂波会显著降低双基地距离和多普勒估计的性能，从而导致目标定位与速度估计的误差。本文提出了一种具有杂波抑制能力的多基地ISAC框架，用于对目标位置和速度进行高保真度估计。为了捕捉密集动态的杂波效应，本文采用随机分布、具有不同多普勒扩展和雷达截面积的散射体对分布式杂波进行建模。本文评估了多种传统信号处理基线方法的杂波抑制性能，结果表明这些方法在强杂波条件下的鲁棒性有限。为解决这一局限，基于深度学习的（摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: 本文提出了一种面向5G及未来通信的多基地通感一体化（ISAC）框架，通过对密集动态杂波进行建模并利用深度学习进行杂波抑制，克服了传统信号处理方法在强杂波环境下鲁棒性不足的问题，实现了高精度的目标位置与速度估计。
